test_title: PYST 35: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 24th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, select ‘No error’ as your answer.**

Jyoti is one of / the best police officer / in this town. / No error
solution:
The erroneous part is **'the best police officer'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here,** 'the best police officers' **should be used instead of** 'the best police officer'.**
 
• The given sentence is an example of subject-verb agreement.
 
• The structure of these kinds of sentences is One + of + the + plural noun + singular verb.
 
 
• *Example: This is one of the best institutions I have ever enrolled in.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is Option 2.

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *Jyoti is one of **the best police officers **in this town.*
